requirements.description: Define textile art. How has it been influenced throughout history? Why is it necessary today to wear clothing made from technical patterns?
What is a pattern? What material is used to make one?
What is the difference between symmetrical and asymmetrical patterns?
What is a prototype or sample garment? Why is it so important in the manufacturing industry?

Explain the following:
  - Warp
  - Weft
  - Selvage
  - Fit
  - Ease/allowance
  - Drafting lines
  - Cutting
  - Finishing
What is the difference between woven fabric and knit fabric?
How are the types of ease or allowance classified? Demonstrate each of them with a design to make them easier to understand.
What materials can be used to make a basic pattern? Explain each of them.
What is a basic pattern? How can it help a dressmaker in their creations?
Why is it important to use size charts? Is there a standard model for them?
Name at least 2 types of cuts that can be used in quick drafting. Give examples of machines that can be used to make these cuts.
Creatively make, develop and explain a technical sheet. Choose any garment and explain in detail all the basic steps in making it.
